concepts.name: resolveScanDestination string|null return-shape contract (card + group-invite branches)
QR lib stays DOM-free and pure — no router, no window navigation inside it
Group-invite shape validation does not pin the origin to few.chat — only /groups/ path + required params gate acceptance
The scanner FAB is a standalone render block that bypasses navItems, so it never leaks into the hamburger overlay
The scanner FAB reuses the bottom tab bar's !hideBottomNav route-visibility predicate rather than defining its own
NpubQrScanner / NpubQrModal are consumed as-is; a non-group framing gets a thin app-level wrapper, never an edit to the group component's semantics
Scanner-facing copy lives under a dedicated 'scanner' i18n namespace (not groups.qr*/scanQr) with mandatory en+de parity, consumed only via useCopy()

stories.remediation_note: Codex P2 (arbitrary-domain URL embedding a valid #c= payload) closed by pathname-gating the card branch to /add|/add/; nostr:-npub preserved via http/https protocol allowlist rather than constructor-catch.

surfaces_touched: app/src/components/QrScanFab.tsx (new — FAB + scanner modal + raw-scan classification wiring)

reviewer_state.whole_assembly: clean; epic ready to finalize (6 remediation rounds, all reviewed clean)

observations.note: #c= marker now declared in 3 modules (contactCard.ts owner, addDeepLink.ts, qr.ts). Enforced by convention. S1-scope forbids exporting from contactCard.ts; promote to one exported constant in a later story that can touch the codec. ALSO: /add pathname now encoded in qr.ts (CARD_LINK_PATHNAME) — third convention-coupled surface; promote marker + path to shared exports in a future story that can touch contactCard.ts.
extractCardLinkPayload re-slices #c= payload that parseContactCard already computes internally. No behavioral bug (identical rule); forked copy. Same root cause as marker duplication.

S2 edited the shared NpubQrScanner directly with two ADDITIVE optional props (onRawScan/startingMessage) — outside S2 scope.includes but a sound reviewed exception: the internal card-only normaliseScanPayload gate structurally rejects group-invite URLs, making AC-SCAN-2 unreachable via unmodified onScan. Existing onScan/normaliseScanPayload/qrStartingCamera semantics preserved byte-for-byte for omitting callers. Ledger concept partially superseded — reconciled, not silent drift. REMEDIATION: onScan made optional; QrScanFab omits it; camera-effect deps now referentially stable — mid-scan restart RESOLVED (Finding 1). Regression-pinned by npubQrScannerOnScanOptional.test.ts.

FAB (z20) stays visible over the open hamburger scrim (z5), consistent with the bottom bar (z10) which also stays above the scrim. AC-FAB-3 (never a hamburger ITEM) holds structurally. Whether the FAB should recede when the menu is open is a product-visual call, not a defect. Surfaced to user.

onScan now optional (fix for camera-restart) means the type permits omitting BOTH onScan and onRawScan (degenerate scanner). No such caller exists; internal component. Not worth a discriminated-union rework. Track only if a future caller supplies neither.

classifyCameraError haystack is err.name ∪ err.message — a superset of the original err.message-only check — so classification is monotonic toward permission-denied; the regression direction (permission-denied → unavailable) is structurally impossible. Guard against any future change that narrows the haystack. AC-SCAN-1 test-gap CLOSED (cameraErrorClassification.test.ts, 11 tests).

Card branch gated on the c= marker (post-nostr-strip): a marker-bearing value must be an absolute http(s) URL with pathname /add or /add/ or it is rejected (falls through to group, then null). Closes nostr:/ftp: scheme-wrapper bypasses a scheme-only gate missed (Fable F2). Guard against reintroducing a not-a-web-URL means card-shaped assumption.

Navigating /add to /add with only a changed hash requires window.location.assign (full reload) because add.tsx deep-link effect is settledRef-gated and excludes the hash from deps; router.push alone is a silent dead-end (Fable F1). Any refactor of add.tsx deep-link effect or QrScanFab nav must preserve this.
Card-resolution tail duplicated across marker and marker-free branches. Non-blocking DRY nit; could hoist behind a single isCardShape boolean. Left as-is.

A query-param-driven full-screen component holding mount-persistent terminal state (JoinRequestCard sent latch) MUST be keyed on the invite-identity param (joinNonce) so a same-route invite change forces a clean remount. The FAB is the first surface that can change ?join= without a route change (Fable confirm Finding A). Mirrors OutboundJoinRequestCard key={record.nonce}.

The same-page /add reload must be CONDITIONAL on destinationPath === currentPath (byte-identical live pathname vs parsed destination pathname). An unconditional reload races and cancels a genuine cross-document assign (Fable confirm Finding B, verified empirically). Handles both trailing-slash-present and -absent live URL shapes.
